header.name: selected_slot
header.evidence: CGENN gallery (FUN_17ca_000f / DAT_0498) reads byte 0 as the current slot 0..5 and writes it back on every save; the game uses it as the character slot for the AUTOMAPS block (DARKSTRT ds:0cf6 <- byte 0 of the file, ovl 1E30:0000)

header.name: slot_in_use
header.evidence: byte 1+slot is the 'occupied' flag of slot 0..5: gallery prints 'Slot %d: Vacant' when it is 0 (CGENN 258e:..), delete clears it, a finished creation sets 1

header.name: unknown_0x7
header.evidence: never read or written by the gallery or the game (only the whole 0xC04-byte file is rewritten around slot changes); zero in every sample

record.name: unknown_0x0
record.evidence: never read or written by any load/save routine; 08 00 00 00 00 00 in every sample slot (also the vacant 'no one' slot)

record.name: ui_color
record.evidence: CGENN 17ca:0064 (load) / 17ca:03b3 (save); DARKSTRT overlay 1E30:0053 / 1E30:0425: save does rec+6 = DAT (CGENN 33b5:01a7 / DARKSTRT ds:0a05); that variable is the colour argument of every window/box draw (the 'GAME COLOR' option); 0x00E0 in all samples

record.name: name
record.evidence: gallery (CGENN 258e) prints rec+8 as the slot name; on load the game's name comes from name_copy (rec+0xe7), on save both are rewritten from it. memset 10 + strcpy: up to 10 chars + NUL

record.name: epithet
record.evidence: load: strcpy(char identity+0xd <- rec+0x13); gallery prints rec+0x13 under the name; memset 10 + strcpy

record.name: gender
record.evidence: copied to identity+0x18; appearance screen shows 'FACIAL HAIR' if 0 else 'FACIAL VEIL'; gallery indexes the Male/Female string table (CGENN ds:01d0) with it

record.name: race
record.evidence: gallery indexes the race pointer table (ds:01d8, 8 entries: Human..Gremlin) with rec+0x1f; creation stat table is indexed race*0x12

record.name: alignment
record.evidence: gallery indexes the Harmony/Chaos table (ds:01f8) with rec+0x20

record.name: guild
record.evidence: gallery indexes the guild table (ds:01b8) with rec+0x21; creation uses it to pick the starting spells (ds:0098), skill (ds:00a4), stats (ds:a480+guild*0x90) and the starter item 0x9c+guild; sample pregens' starting spell/skill ranks match their guild exactly

record.name: level
record.evidence: identity+0x1c in memory; gallery prints 'Level %d' from it, stats sheet (1E65:0861) prints it, level-up loop (1E65:0000) increments it; all stock pregens have level 0. DARKSTRT refuses to enter on-line play with an off-line-flagged character at level >= 20 (see invariants)

record.name: item_charges
record.evidence: 32 bytes -> char+0xbb+i, one per item slot. An item has charges exactly when its record's default (+0x1c) is above 0. Yserbius: 0 = not set, the loader 0A7B:0733 copies the default in; empty slots and plain items hold 0.

automap.evidence: DARKSTRT overlay 1E69: ovl_1E69_02D4 (load: 0xFF-fill 256 bytes, then read 800 bytes at (DS:0cf6*0x22 + level_index)*0x320 from automaps.dat), ovl_1E69_0390 (save: every cell not 0xFF/0x0C/0x0D/0x0E becomes 0, then write 800 bytes), ovl_1E69_1433 (map table lookup, ds:0b46), ovl_1E69_0704 (renderer: planes at +0x52, +0x152, +0x252, +0x352, +0x362 of the dialog object, 6x5 pixel cells); CGENN 1000:7bb6..7c0c (new character: 0x6A40 bytes of 0xFF at slot*0x22*0x320)

catalog.evidence: RESOURCE.038 decoded (rol 6 per word); charges = record +0x1c when above 0; research/items-ys-tw

invariants: Everything in a slot between record offsets 8 and 0x1CB inclusive (0x1C4 bytes) is encrypted with the CGENN/TWGENN cipher (docs/server/ybarra.md section 2); bytes 0-7 and 0x1CC-0x1F5 are plain. No checksum, no length field, no per-record key: the cipher key is constant (the file is just re-encrypted slot by slot).

Mode bytes: rec+0x17D/rec+0x1AB must be (1,0) (on-line) or (6,6) (off-line). Anything else makes DARKSTRT print 'Unable to Load copied Characters!' (or, if rec+0x17D is 0, 'Unable To Load Beta Characters!') and exit. An off-line (6,6) character with level >= 20 is refused for on-line play ('Your character is an off-line character above level 20.'); use (1,0) for server-side characters.
name (0x08) and name_copy (0xE7) must be equal: the game loads the name from 0xE7 only, the gallery shows 0x08; the next save rewrites both from the in-memory name.

health_current/mana_current are separate copies from health_max/mana_max (no cross-check on load); set both when raising max (a freshly saved character has current == max). The main loop clamps health_current to 32000.

Attribute clamps (CGENN 183a:0093) apply only inside the creation/spinner screens, NOT on load; limits to respect: strength/defense 0..99, initiative/agility 0..50, dexterity 0..3200, health_max/mana_max <= 32000, spell and skill ranks 0..12.
gold <= 99,999,999 and experience <= 999,999,999 (the add functions clamp to these). A higher stored value is not rejected on load but is clamped at the next change.

Raising experience above the level threshold makes the Guild Hall level-up loop (1E65:0000) advance the level and add the level-table gains to dexterity, health_max, mana_max and the three point pools; raising level directly does NOT grant those gains.
map_code must be one of the 34 table values (automap.maps[].code) and position must be a valid cell of that map; new characters/death re-entry use the entrance map.
Header byte 1+slot must be 1 for the slot to appear; header byte 0 must be a slot 0..5.

AUTOMAPS.DAT must stay 168000 bytes; the game reads/writes 800-byte blocks at (slot*34 + mapindex)*800 (see automap). CGENN 'Replace' character fills the slot's 27200 bytes with 0xFF; do the same for a freshly created slot.
